precedence: This v4 amendment supersedes v3 as the effective Auth-lane boundary. It replaces the incorrect Gateway test path, opens only the exact trusted-session carrier and complete activated-capability traversal paths below, and retains every v3 exact route tuple, equivalence key, response schema, fresh command binding, denial and false authority flag not explicitly strengthened here.
closedSetRule: The backend v49 Auth-lane implementation commit may change only files in effectiveExactChangedPathClosedSet. Every predecessor glob is narrowed to this effective list. Any other changed path, including a business controller/service or the retired Gateway test path, is a hard denial requiring a new append-only exact-path amendment.

trustedElevatedSessionCarrierException.purpose: Make ELEVATED reachable only from canonical fresh assurance on the active Auth database session and carry that server-owned result through /auth/me and verified Gateway identity into ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter.
requiredAuthBehavior: Auth resolves the presented JWT token id to an active, non-revoked, non-expired and non-idle-expired AuthSession database row and verifies exact userId, tenantId and sessionFamilyId identity binding.

Auth emits ELEVATED only when authenticationMethod is canonical OIDC_STEP_UP, assuranceAcr exactly equals dwp.auth.step-up.required-acr, assuranceAmr satisfies the existing OidcStepUpAmrPolicy MFA rule, and authenticatedAt is within dwp.auth.step-up.maximum-authentication-age-seconds subject only to the existing clock tolerance.

An active identity-bound session that lacks any one assurance condition is deterministically downgraded to NORMAL. A missing or invalid active session remains an authentication failure rather than a downgrade.
GET /auth/me adds the server-owned activeAccessMode field with exactly NORMAL or ELEVATED; no request value or caller header participates in its computation.
requiredGatewayBehavior: AuthSessionVerifier accepts only exact NORMAL or ELEVATED from a successful /auth/me projection.
A missing activeAccessMode is NORMAL only for rolling compatibility; blank, unknown, wrong-type or malformed values make authority unavailable.

VerifiedIdentity carries the normalized mode and VerifiedIdentityFilter removes every caller-supplied X-DWP-Active-Access-Mode value before placing the verified mode in a server-owned ServerWebExchange attribute.
ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter reads only that server-owned attribute. A missing attribute is NORMAL and a valid provider support session has PROVIDER_SUPPORT precedence over ELEVATED.
No client, browser, reverse-proxy or test request header can assert ELEVATED.

completeActivatedCapabilityTraversalExce.purpose: Apply one complete activated-capability traversal to generation, Auth topology validation and Gateway high-risk classification so a STEP_UP_REQUIRED result for an activated expression member is challenged rather than converted to 503.
requiredTraversal: Every CAPABILITY_EXPRESSION.capabilityContractKeys member when mode is ANY.
Every CAPABILITY_EXPRESSION.capabilityContractKeys member when mode is ALL.
requiredSemantics: All three layers resolve the complete required-access capability set against the same registry and fail closed on a missing reference.
An active HIGH or CRITICAL capability whose non-empty activationPolicy begins with STEPUP- marks the Gateway route as high-risk-step-up-capable whether direct or nested in ANY or ALL.
Auth preserves normal ANY and ALL authorization truth; Gateway classification recognizes STEP_UP_REQUIRED but never turns an ordinary deny into a challenge.

route.hcm.operations.payroll-run.data is covered through its ANY expression over hcm.operations.payroll-run.execute and hcm.operations.payroll-support.view; NORMAL STEP_UP_REQUIRED becomes a challenge, not 503, and ELEVATED reevaluates the exact expression and predicates.

genericSessionStepUpTopologyException.paySemantics: Payroll population PAGE, payroll-support DATA and payroll-run DATA become reachable only through trusted carrier elevation followed by exact policy reevaluation. Payroll prepare and calculate remain ELEVATED plus their exact fresh command-bound proof.
forbidden: An empty command binding on any route outside the exact generic-session-only closed set.
Removing or weakening the TIME close/reopen or PAY prepare/calculate fresh command binding.
Capability splitting, predicate weakening or business behavior changes.

Public authority endpoints retain all existing public-path and revision-header validation.
Public authorityEndpoint lookup and every public route or namespace lookup are null-safe and can never match or dispatch the internal-only endpoint.
The correction introduces no public route and no authentication or CSRF bypass for a public endpoint.
